notes.title: MOBA Match Live - 5v5 - Tournament of Tamers
notes.notes:
Tournament of Tamers is a fast-paced Dragon MOBA, featuring gameplay modes like Arena, Battle Royale, MOBA and Base Defense. There’s a talent tree for every ability in the game, no level cap, deep tactical gameplay and mythology based on the world of Runic.

We have super fun playtests every Wednesday at 7:30pm PST in our Discord! All are welcome and it's always a good time!

Discord Invite: https://discord.gg/UHhAdsM

notes.title: October Update
notes.notes:
[h2]4 dragon backstories have been released[/h2]
[previewyoutube=9Dz0jUpg5R8;full]Wodenic[/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=GWfR5n2wKGM;full]Terror[/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=xx-t1tp0KHU;full]Doom[/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=DNNi8dZFfNc;full]Divine[/previewyoutube]

[h2]Our new website has been released[/h2]
- [url=buhgaming.com/items]Items page[/url]
- [url=buhgaming.com/levels]Levels page[/url]
- [url=buhgaming.com/home ]New homepage[/url]

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
- Upgraded to the PUN2 networking engine for improved network synchronization.
- New HUD design.
- Fixed a bug where seeking objects like Soul Blast would get lost. 
- Balance changes to all 9 dragons. 
- Towers are better at defending themselves, striking back at players who hit them from outside their normal range.
- Turned down basic attack sounds.
- Camera shakes when you take a heavy hit.
- UI cleaner and more polished in the character selection scene.
- High Peak Arena has more sheep healing stations.
- new 3 icons for top level talents.

notes.title: 44 new achievements added
notes.notes:
[h1]Achievements[/h1]

Each dragon has 4 primary abilities. Each of these abilities has it's own talent tree, with an Ultimate Talent at the top. 

There are now Steam Achievements for getting each of these 36 Ultimate Talents.

Additionally, winning 50 games with any single dragon gives you a mastery achievement for that dragon!
